rows.answer: I am from Kyoto, an old city of temples and quiet lanes.
Nara, Japan. The deer walk in the streets.
A small town on Shikoku island in Japan. Mild and green.
Kanazawa, Japan, a castle town by the sea.
Kagoshima, in the south of Japan. Warm, with a volcano across the bay.
A fishing port on the coast of Hokkaido, Japan.
Hiroshima, Japan, on a bay with seven rivers.
Fukuoka, Japan, a port city on the west coast.
Hong Kong. Towers, rain and lights all night.
Shanghai, a huge city of glass towers.
Singapore. Hot, wet and full of skyscrapers.
Manhattan, New York. Towers, steam and traffic.
Tokyo. I live among the towers of Shinjuku, neon on every wall.
Shenzhen, a wall of glass skyscrapers on the bay.
A city whose skyline is a wall of glass towers, lit up all night.
Kowloon, in Hong Kong. Dense towers on every side.
West Texas. Flat, dry and hot.
A ranch outside Tucson, Arizona. Cactus all around.
The outback of Western Australia. Red dirt and heat.
Sonora, Mexico. Desert heat and dust.
New Mexico. Mesas and open sky.
Chihuahua, in the north of Mexico. Dry plains and mountains.
A small town in the Nevada desert.
Alice Springs, in the Australian outback.
A village in the Swiss Alps. Green meadows and cows with bells.
Tyrol, Austria. Mountain meadows and wooden farmhouses.
Rolling green hills in Devon, England. Sheep and hedgerows.
A farm in Vermont. Green hills in summer.
Bavaria, Germany. Villages under the Alps.
The Dutch countryside, with green fields and windmills.
A valley in Slovenia. Alpine meadows and a lake.
The Cotswolds in England. Gentle green hills and stone villages.
Northern Norway, deep in a fjord. The winter is long and dark.
The north of Scotland. Moor and fog by the sea.
Siberia. Endless pine forest and cold.
Iceland. Black sand and storms off the sea.
The fens of eastern England. Flat, grey and wet.
Kamchatka. Volcanoes and ash.
Lapland in Finland. Snow forest and the polar night.
A storm-battered coast in western Ireland. Grey sea and black cliffs.
My brother Wren. He is all I have left, and I keep him safe.
My little girl Ada. Nobody touches her while I am around.
My mom. She is sick and somebody has to look after her.
My brother Wren. They took everything from him and I want them to pay.
My dad. The man who hurt him is still out there walking free.
For Mara. She was betrayed by people she trusted and I will settle it.
For my dad. I want him to see me win, just once.
My coach Vic. I want to be the best there is and make him proud.
My sister Lou. Everyone back home will know my name.
For Wren. We are getting out of this town and nobody will own us again.
My wife Noor. We quit, sell everything and take the open road.
For my friend Eli. He is stuck in a job that is killing him and I want us both free.
For Wren. I want to show him what is past the edge of the map.
My daughter Bea. We want to see every strange place out there and learn how it works.
For my grandpa. He taught me to wonder what is beyond the stars and I want to find out.
Nobody. Just the open road and no one telling me what to do.
Myself, I guess. I want to see how far I can go.
